items.item_text: Please list ALL required licenses/qualifications on your application and resume. Any applications missing the necessary requirements will not be considered.*
R. EEG T. Certification – required within six months of employment

Play a key role in the delivery of world class patient care. Continuously elevate the quality of care within an award winning health system. Leverage your expertise to make a life changing difference. At UCLA Health, you can do this and more.

At the level of EEG Technologist it is expected that the individual be capable of self-direction with minimal supervision. It is expected for the EEG technologist to hold the basic rudiments of EEG acquisition. Artifact detection/elimination skills should be adequate. The technologist should be able to describe EEG findings to junior faculty in a review style format. The EEG Technologist must be flexible enough to learn new protocols i.e. Adult and Pediatric Telemetries, ICU continuous EEG, Outpatient, Portable Studies. Based on departmental needs, the EEG Technologist (PT) may be required to float to other UCLA sites, must participate in the on-call schedule and be flexible and available with the work schedule. Our ideal candidate will have completed an electroencephalography program.
